    Lore Inspiration — Ge'or Master Summary¶

    Authoritative reference. All new lore must align with this document. Do not write story without Mikhail's approval.

    Table of Contents¶

    • PART 1: The Universe Before Ge'or
    • PART 2: The Ages of Ge'or
    • PART 3: The Modern Era
    • PART 4: The Protagonists
    • PART 5: The World

    PART 1: THE UNIVERSE BEFORE GE'OR¶

    Chapter 1: The Shadows Are Born (~6000 BCE, Old Earth)¶

    A group of pre-philosophers — the intellectual elite of the ancient Middle East — gathered around a campfire after a war that had killed hundreds from both rival tribes. They debated through the night and reached a conclusion: humanity needed a "god" — a demiurge — to carry it forward without conflict. This god would be the nation-state. To build it, the freedom of all humans would need to be sacrificed.

    Over millennia, these philosophers worked in the shadows of society — hence the name "Shadows" and the race "Hybrian Shadows." They created finance, coinage, justice systems, secret societies, mathematics, and religion — all tools to guide humanity toward their vision.

    Chapter 2: The Rebel Faction¶

    Some philosophers — Socrates, Plato, and others — rejected the plan. Socrates was executed for revealing the truth. The rebel faction persisted across history: early Christians, original Protestants, American Revolutionaries, libertarians. On Ge'or, their descendants became the Ironcloak. Their goal: bring humanity to the truth.

    Chapter 3: The Long Manipulation¶

    The American Revolution cost the Shadows centuries of empire-building. The Shadows fabricated the 19th-century spiritual awakening and corrupted European liberal revolutions. They dehumanized humanity — neighbor against neighbor, parent against child. The 20th century was a testing ground: two world wars eliminated imperialism, fascism, and monarchy. Freedom won — barely. 21st-century deconstruction exploited greed, envy, and hate to undermine freedom globally.

    Chapter 4: The Takeover (2030 CE)¶

    An engineered global war and economic collapse brought the Shadows to power. They took humanity to the stars, creating a totalitarian surveillance state with humans as neurons. Their god was given a face and a name: Hybrian (from "hybrid").

    Chapter 5: The Rebel Escape¶

    Before the takeover was complete, a rebel faction escaped to the asteroid belt. They waged a guerrilla war and were annihilated — but launched refugee ships beyond the galaxy. Humanity survived.

    Chapter 6: The Last Great War (~3,000,000 Years)¶

    The war against the Hybrian hivemind lasted three million years. Hundreds of thousands of galaxies consumed. During the war: humans developed mage-cells, elves became genetically immune to hivemind absorption. No one won. All economies collapsed to medieval levels. Technology was lost. Science became religion.

    Chapter 7: The Final Push (~40,000 Years Before 597 AGD)¶

    Humanity crashed its remaining mothership into Old Earth, destroying the Shadow empire's core. The Union of Sovereign Planets imprisoned the surviving Hybrian hivemind in the Fortress Planet. The Shadows had already escaped. They went into hibernation.

    Chapter 8: The 157th Colony — Ge'or Before the Crash¶

    Ge'or was the 157th colonized solar system — a human weapons research facility. Researchers created a black DNA agent — programmed to seek a human female host. The Hybrians glassed the planet, killing all humans. The research bunker survived. The black agent survived.

    Chapter 9: The Glorious Alliance¶

    The Glorious Alliance — a massive arcology ship — was sabotaged by Captain Mad-Dog (a Shadow). A 12-year-old girl named Xiumi crawled through vents for 8 days and pressed a button to save the ship. Her soul split into three — one fragment became Nethra. The ship emerged ~15,000 BGD and crashed into Ge'or, destroying a moon and creating The Silver Bride. Age 1 began.

    PART 2: THE AGES OF GE'OR¶

    Age Name Span Key Event
    1 Nomadism ~15,000–14,000 BGD Post-crash survival, species dispersal
    2 First Tribes 10,999–9,000 BGD Demons gain enmity, climate stabilizes
    3 First Empires 8,999–7,000 BGD Writing invented, agriculture kingdoms
    4 Dragon Tyranny 6,999–5,500 BGD Twelve clans rule 90%, death wars
    5 Dwarf Era 5,499–4,500 BGD Romanium prosperity, Golden War
    6 Iron/Elvish Age 4,499–2,989 BGD Elvengar empire, Hybrian crash
    7 Human Age 2,999–1,000 BGD Continent empires, countism origin
    8 Age of Baoth 999–421 BGD Surveillance state, Demonic War
    9 Lost Era 399–300 BGD Anarchy, Eris cult fabricated
    10 Erisian Era 300 BGD–Year 0 Church expansion, Ironcloak founded
    11 Great Divergence Year 0–610 AGD Current era, protagonists born 597
    12 — After 610 AGD To be written

    Chapter 11: The Old Lumina Empire (1729–1134 BGD)¶

    The Old Lumina Empire controlled 70% of Lumina Continent, Cattos island, and parts of Tuba. Its greatest ruler, Luminous XII "the Architect," committed suicide in 1134 BGD after losing to the Goblin King — a battle the Shadows had engineered. The empire collapsed. Marti barbarians invaded.

    Chapter 12: The Shadows Arrive (~2989 BGD)¶

    The Hybrian vessel detected human biosignatures on Ge'or by chance. Crashed in Pontus. Built subterranean complex. Began their plan.

    Chapter 13: The Demonic War (466–421 BGD)¶

    Kirivis, the Demon King, discovered the Shadows' infiltration of Baoth. Attacked without explanation — 45-year war. Beheaded by Rulfred, a Shadow agent. Died a villain — and a hero.

    Chapter 14: Nethra and the Ironcloak¶

    Kirivis's adopted daughter Nethra — whose soul was a fragment of Xiumi — marched to avenge him. The spirits of the Lyrical Forest gave her a device: the Gift from 3,000,000 Years. She detonated it, destroyed Baoth, was transformed into a different type of Shadow, and secretly founded the Ironcloak. She walks among the Shadows, unknown.

    Chapter 15: The Erisian Church¶

    The Shadows fabricated Eris — a homunculus posing as goddess of Discord, Chaos, and Confusion. Staged miracles, faked deaths, preached obedience and donation. After her staged departure, followers created holy orders, conquered lands, founded the Pontificate of Eris, and launched crusades.

    Chapter 16: The Great Divergence (Year 0)¶

    The Glorious Alliance reactor malfunctioned. Created The Groom vortex. Destroyed Elvengar. Began the Kutten Catastrophe.

    PART 3: THE MODERN ERA (AGD)¶

    Date Event
    1–100 AGD Kutten Catastrophe — elven diaspora
    27 AGD Erisian Empire founded by Davos the Magnificent
    94 AGD Vennerian Trade Republic breaks from Empire
    137 AGD Great Elvish Persecution (Shadow-engineered)
    158 AGD Anos Plutocracy founded
    214–236 AGD Great Erisian Empire War
    589 AGD Sister-queen takes over Xikxia
    597 AGD Present day — protagonists born

    The Shadow Plan (6 Phases)¶

    1. Infiltration — seed institutions, create homunculi
    2. Fragmentation — engineer wars, prevent unification
    3. Consolidation — gain power country by country
    4. Unification — covert global dictatorship
    5. Assimilation — planetary hivemind
    6. Victory — restart the Last Great War

    Armageddon is Phase 4 — simultaneous ice age weapon, Pontus goblin army, Groom detonation, Church prophecy.

    PART 4: THE PROTAGONISTS¶

    Two boys born in 597 AGD in the Grimmel Republic, 12 km apart. Created by the Black Agent from the 157th Colony. Top 0.001% magical potential. Visited by the Hope Goddess before birth with a warning: the Shadows are taking over the hope realm. Mission: destroy the hivemind in the Fortress Planet.

    PART 5: THE WORLD¶

    • Planet: Ge'or — 1.37× Old Earth. Ring: The Silver Bride. Moons: Maenar, Amelia, Keg.
    • Calendar: 12 months × 40 days, 26-hour days. 1 Ge'orian year ≈ 1.42 Earth years.
    • 15+ continents, 8 oceans, 150+ nations, 30+ species.
    • Six main races: Humans, Dwarves, Elves, Demons, Beast Races, Catmen.
    • SS-tier powers: Erisian Empire, Asatru Empire, Vennerian Trade Republic.
    • Magic: Bioengineered mage-cells — not supernatural. No one on Ge'or knows this.
    • The Archive of the Traveler: Unopened, in the Ruins of Baoth. Contains the true history.
    • Eternal Paradise: Shadow base on Romanium Island. Neutron bomb. Universe-as-black-goo endgame.
